author: Kung Fu Man
title: Book cover art commission — fantasy + realistic faces, no AI
content:
Alright, going to try this.

Sending a shout on here that I need an art commission that can do fantasy-style artwork and realistic people and faces for a book cover. I have an editing design and layout put together with AI assistance. If that's off-putting, it's what it is.

If you are interested, please DM me with examples of your work. I want to make it clear I want the final product to be drawn WITHOUT AI.

Despite my usage for the mockup, I want final to be strictly human-made. I am also aiming for professional quality but at reasonable prices
